fieldguide.block.bosses_of_mass_destruct: A flower, resonated with a powerful Void Blossom. When placed, it will emit particles in the direction of the nearest Blossom Hideout.
fieldguide.entity.bosses_of_mass_destruc: Found deep in the Nether, the Gauntlet is a powerful sentry built long ago. As you might expect, target the eye, and avoid the massive beam of fueled by pure hatred it will occasionally fire.
A powerful spellcaster, ruler of the undead night. It commands swaths of Phantoms to do it's bidding, and will unleash deadly ranged spells until you crumble to dust.

A monolith with one mission: eliminate the threat. While it is largely immobile, it can teleport, channel explosive bursts, and generate runic blocks that must be broken with a Netherite Picaxe or better. Shukers seem to revere it with great fervor.
A flower imbued with the strength of the void. It can call upon thorny vines, root foes in place, and draw forth the power of all nearby plants.
